# Gilbert Blythe & Uncle Jim

- [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — Friend of — [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) — friendly acquaintances who share a laugh · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P57](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P24](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0024)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are welcomed to their new home at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) by [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md), his wife, and Captain Jim. They enjoy a lively supper together while learning about their surrounding neighbors and the local community.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM

> Captain Jim entertains [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Doctor Dave](../character/doctor-dave.md) by telling the romantic story of the house's first bride and her schoolmaster husband. Afterwards, he bids his hosts farewell and shares with [Anne](../character/anne.md) their common bond as 'kindred spirits.'
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

> Captain Jim and [Anne](../character/anne.md) bond over their shared nature as "kindred spirits," or people who belong to the race that knows [Joseph](../character/joseph.md). As the guests prepare to leave in the moonlight, Captain Jim shares stories and praises the beauty of [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). After everyone departs, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk through their garden, grateful for their happy home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) Light in the evening, encountering the strangely bearded [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) along the way. At the lighthouse, Captain Jim warmly welcomes them, showing them his model schooner, the mechanism of the light, and his orange cat, the [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md). Over tea and a driftwood fire, Captain Jim explains [Marshall](../character/marshall.md) Elliott's political vow and shares stories of his past and saved animals.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

> Captain Jim explains how he rescued the [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md) and shares why he preferred dogs to cats. He then shows [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) his collection of curios and enthalls them with vivid, true tales from his adventurous life at sea. After reminiscing and inviting them back, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walk home reflecting on Captain Jim's character and past.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes for a evening walk on the shore of [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and encounters [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), her mysterious neighbor. They share a conversation about their surroundings, beauty, and pasts before agreeing to exchange visits. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her encounter and impressions of [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at their home, where she enjoys fudge, conversation, and the offer to borrow books. Despite relaxing and showing her warm, joyful side during the visit, she becomes distant again when leaving as she reflects on what she lacks. After [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) departs, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a tender moment discussing beauty and Anne's hair color.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks through a foggy evening to visit [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), but turns back after seeing [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) weeping intensely in private. Outside, she meets Captain Jim leading [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) home; Captain Jim then walks [Anne](../character/anne.md) back to her house while they discuss [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and Dick's tragic situation.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) spend autumn evenings visiting Captain Jim at the lighthouse, often accompanied by [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). On their walk home, they discuss Leslie's wasted potential before turning to affectionate teaseing about Anne's past suitor and their shared joy in their own home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) visiting from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia join as dinner guests, engaging in lively debate and storytelling over the holiday meal.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) walk to the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse to ring in the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) with Captain Jim, his nephew Joe, [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), and the [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md). After music, dancing, and storytelling around the fire, Captain Jim opens the door at midnight to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

> During a cold winter, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend time together, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) senses a lingering distance and occasional resentment from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). Captain Jim explains to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that Leslie's past tragedy creates a barrier between them. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) hints at her pregnancy, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) reacts coldly but later gifts her a handmade baby dress. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shares his journal of sea adventures with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who hope someone will one day write his life story.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER

> As spring arrives at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) to decorate her garden beds with shells and bring her sweet-grass and mayflowers. Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim engage in lively, humorous debates about religion, books, and local neighbors alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). When [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) returns with news about a sick neighbor, her unconscious funny remark causes Captain Jim and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to step outside to laugh.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arrives to stay with [Anne](../character/anne.md), and soon after, [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes into labor and gives birth to a baby girl named Joyce. Tragically, the baby dies shortly after birth, devastating [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and their friends. [Anne](../character/anne.md) endures a long, difficult recovery filled with deep grief, struggling to reconcile her loss while receiving support from her loved ones.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne.md) to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) to sit outdoors, leaving her with Captain Jim while he sees a patient. Sitting among the rocks, Captain Jim comforts [Anne](../character/anne.md) regarding her lost baby Joyce and shares the tragic story of his long-lost love, [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). He asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) to remember [Margaret](../character/margaret.md) and pass her story on to future generations so she won't be forgotten.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 20 LOST MARGARET

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) insist that [Anne](../character/anne.md) keep [Susan](../character/susan.md) on as hired help for the summer to regain her health. Captain Jim and [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) visit [Anne](../character/anne.md), exchanging humorous banter about fruit-stealing boys and local robins. Miss Cornelia reports that [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) has agreed to take in a summer boarder, [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), who is a writer and the grandson of the house's original owner.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home and discusses [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md), after which Owen visits and enjoys a moonlit sail with them. Two nights later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) takes Owen to [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) to introduce him to Captain Jim, who recounts old memories and thrilling sea tales. Impressed by Captain Jim's experiences, Owen is enthralled by his life-book and borrows it to read at home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) agrees to write Captain Jim's life story combined with the tale of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and he sets up a workspace at the lighthouse. Over a memorable summer, Owen works intensely on the manuscript while spending joyful leisure time with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and Captain Jim. As September arrives, Owen finishes the main draft of his book and announces that his stay at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) is coming to an end.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) accompanies [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the harbor to the sand shore, where she meets [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) wandering alone in distress. [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) tearfully confesses her unrequited love for [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), while [Anne](../character/anne.md) comforts her and keeps Owen's own feelings secret. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) collects them in his boat, and later at home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discourages [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) from speculating on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and Owen's hypothetical match.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) to read obituaries and gossip about local history and Owen Ford's effect on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) enters, the conversation shifts to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) mourning her old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), before [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) spend the holidays in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and return to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), where Captain Jim shares news that his life-book will be published.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discusses with [Anne](../character/anne.md) his belief that an operation on [Dick](../character/dick.md) Moore's skull could restore his memory and sanity. [Anne](../character/anne.md) strongly opposes telling [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), arguing that it would inflict further misery and financial strain on her. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) maintains that it is his medical and moral duty to tell [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) the truth and give her the choice, despite Doctor Dave's advice to leave well enough alone.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) visit Captain Jim to discuss whether [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) should be told about the operation that might cure [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md). Despite Anne's reservations, Captain Jim agrees with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) must be informed. [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) ultimately decides to proceed with taking [Dick](../character/dick.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the operation, while Miss Cornelia later vents her fierce disapproval to [Anne](../character/anne.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) prepares her house and borrows money from Captain Jim before travelling to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for Dick's operation. After returning home, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) wait anxiously for news, until [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives a shocking letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) revealing that the man was actually Dick's cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md), and that the real [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md) died years ago.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

> [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) arrives at Anne's home in shock after hearing the news about [Dick](../character/dick.md) Moore's identity. They discuss how the resemblance between cousins [George](../character/george.md) and [Dick](../character/dick.md) led to the years-long mix-up, Leslie's newly found freedom, and the possibility of informing [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) gives birth to a healthy ten-pound baby boy, bringing immense joy to the household after her earlier grief. Friends and family visit to admire the newborn, whom [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name [James Matthew](../character/james-a.md) after Captain Jim and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Miss Cornelia also reveals in secret that [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) plans to return for a visit.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

> During a federal election, Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim discuss political opinions with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md), celebrating or lamenting the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits the lighthouse, where she unknowingly snubs a freshly shaved [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) before having a poignant conversation with Captain Jim about his impending death, his lost love [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and his wish for [Anne](../character/anne.md) to care for [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS

> Owen and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) confess their love for one another in the garden and seal their commitment. Afterward, they gather with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Captain Jim, who offers a warm and solemn benediction for their futures before taking his leave. [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns late from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), bringing news and expressing her surprise over Miss Cornelia's upcoming marriage.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) present Captain Jim with the published copy of his life-book written by [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md), which fills him with joy as he entertains them with tea. The next morning, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) notices the lighthouse light is still burning after sunrise and goes with [Anne](../character/anne.md) to investigate. They enter the lighthouse and discover Captain Jim has peacefully passed away in his sleep with his life-book on his chest.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR
